items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Steve Lewis, uh, this Jackson, Udell, I don't know what his last name was, he played back there.

ctx.x: Do you remember any other guys that played piano like that?

Steve Lewis, uh, this Jackson, Udell, I don't know what his last name was, he played back there. Oh, there was, there was a, there was a, there was some white fellas played back there, I think Buzzy Williams played back there. Uh, but the, the, the, the three that I can remember the most was Steve Lewis and, uh, and Udell.
How did Steve Lewis play? Fine, played wonderful.
